name: Mobbin
description: Mobbin is the industry standard in UI & UX design references for mobile apps, web apps, and websites. The platform serves millions of product builders and designers across the world to help them design better digital experiences. Connect Mobbin with Cline to better research and explore UI & UX design ideas.

install.notes: Requires a Mobbin Pro, Team, or Enterprise plan. On first connection, sign in with your Mobbin account in the browser to authorize access via OAuth. No API key or manual token setup is needed.
